decision: The competitor (Alpine F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
event_name: Document 27 Date 10 September 2021 Time 20:19 2021 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 September 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 18, 19) and heard from the team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the
fact: Team member in the pit lane operating in an unsafe manner.
offence: Breach of 12.2.1h of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video evidence. Several cars were released into the pit lane at the same time. The team member of Car 31 who was responsible for releasing Car 31 stepped back into the pit lane, close to the fast lane into the path of Car 5. While the Stewards accept that members of other teams also stepped this far into the pit lane, they did not obstruct another car and were not in a particularly dangerous situation. In the case of Car 31 the Stewards determined that this was an "unsafe act."
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Alpine Pit Lane Incident
